title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - BreakerState
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/BreakerState. [COSEM] This class manages an internal or external disconnect unit of the meter (e.g. electricity breaker, gas valve) in order to connect or disconnect -- partly or entirely -- the premises of the consumer to / from the supply. Subclass of saref:State (core SAREF).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'BreakerState'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasOutputState.description: Property. [COSEM] Shows the actual physical state of the device connection to the supply: (true) Connected, (false) Disconnected.

hasControlState.description: Property. Shows the internal state of the disconnect control object: (0) Disconnected, (1) Connected, (2) Ready for reconnection.

hasControlMode.description: Property. [COSEM] Configures the behaviour of the disconnect control object for all triggers, i.e. the possible state transitions.

hasObis.description: Property. [COSEM/IEC 62056] OBIS code uniquely identifying this breaker/disconnect-control COSEM object.
